title: Linux
machine: 4 CPU / 4 GiB Debian LXC on a shared host; Xvfb 1280×800, Openbox, software rendering.
memory_metric: PSS: proportional set size of the whole process tree
notes: Alternating AB/BA blocks, isolated offline profiles with identical 51,000-file fixtures (default indexing limits differ), one 60-second priming launch per profile.
Snapshots sum current descendants about every 100 ms; short-lived or reparented processes can be missed. Observer and shared-host load were not subtracted.
